api.name: FLUX.2 [klein] 9b

api.name: FLUX.2 [klein] base-4b

api.name: Z-Image Turbo
api.about: Z-Image Turbo, 6B, Apache 2.0: text to image in 9 steps, good at text in pictures; mflux's 4-bit pack (5.5 GB), for Macs with 16 GB. No editing with reference images

api.name: Qwen-Image 2512
api.about: Qwen-Image 2512, 20B, Apache 2.0: text to image with true CFG; strong at text in pictures (also Chinese). Slow (two passes per step) and soft compared with FLUX; edits need Qwen-Image-Edit

api.name: Qwen-Image-Edit 2511
api.about: Qwen-Image-Edit 2511, 20B, Apache 2.0: edits one to a few reference images following the prompt (needs at least one; several can be combined) and keeps what the prompt leaves alone. Slow (two passes per step)

api.name: Qwen-Image 2.1
api.about: Qwen-Image 2.1, 7B transformer with a Qwen3-VL text encoder: text to image, 40 steps without guidance. Qwen Research Licence: non-commercial only

api.name: SeedVR2 3B
api.about: SeedVR2 3B (ByteDance), Apache 2.0: upscales an image 2× or 4× (at most 4096 px) and adds detail without repainting it; one step, seconds to a minute

api.name: SeedVR2 7B
api.about: SeedVR2 7B (ByteDance), Apache 2.0: the larger upscaler, finer detail; slower and about 17 GB

api.name: BiRefNet
api.about: BiRefNet (ZhengPeng7), MIT: removes the background of an image — a soft alpha matte, edges cleaned for a dark backdrop, glows and shadows kept on a plain background; 1024² inside, 1–3 s an image on a Mac, 450 MB

api.name: BiRefNet HR matting
api.about: BiRefNet HR matting (ZhengPeng7), MIT: trained for soft alpha (hair, fur, smoke) at 2048² inside; finer edges for large pictures; slower (about 4–5 s on a Mac) and far more GPU memory (MPS took up to 26 GB)

api.name: BiRefNet lite
api.about: BiRefNet lite (ZhengPeng7), MIT: the small backbone (Swin-T), 180 MB — quicker, for the CPU or a small GPU; coarser edges than BiRefNet

api.name: LTX-2.5 (q4)
api.about: LTX-2.5 22B audio+video, int4 (Gemma 4 text encoder): distilled two-stage, fits 32 GB

api.name: LTX-2.5 (q8)
api.about: LTX-2.5 22B audio+video, int8: better quality, wants 64 GB

api.name: LTX-2.5 HQ (q4)
api.about: LTX-2.5 HQ 22B audio+video, int4: the open dev model with real CFG (res_2s sampler, 15 steps) at half size, then the distilled LoRA refines at full size — the closest local thing to Lightricks' hosted LTX-2.5 Pro (API only). More detail and closer prompt following than the distilled model, but about 6× slower (q8, 512×320, 49 frames: 5.7 min against 1 min distilled, peak ~30 GB); fits 32 GB at small sizes. Shares the folder of LTX-2.5 (q4): adds the dev transformer and the distilled LoRA

api.name: LTX-2.5 HQ (q8)

More detail and closer prompt following than the distilled model, but about 6× slower (q8, 512×320, 49 frames: 5.7 min against 1 min distilled, peak ~30 GB); wants 48 GB or more.
